baseline_contract: Reuse existing models.current.baseline.feature/update and scripts.prepare_initial_baselines.fit unchanged; add separate cutoff-aligned admission wrapper. Preserve exact legacy causal_rows callable and control as original-procedure diagnostic, not same-cutoff primary comparator.

cutoff_policy.admission: history start < UTC midnight(cutoff) minus one day; authentic result_available_at_utc <= cutoff when supplied
cutoff_policy.default_historical: event authoritative start minus exactly one microsecond, chosen before any training/evaluation/control feature generation
cutoff_policy.explicit_current: retain supplied timezone-aware prestart cutoff exactly
cutoff_policy.monotonicity: equal cutoffs allowed for simultaneous starts; decreasing cutoffs rejected
cutoff_policy.receipt: same pre-feature cutoff, no post-feature clipping or backdating

defect: Historical features defaulted to event start; receipt rewrote start to start minus one microsecond. UTC-midnight events therefore recorded a prior-day cutoff incompatible with admitted feature history.
matched_control: Same repaired efficiency training IDs and exact repaired efficiency prediction events; reuse candidate predictions; no additional refit or selection of challenger.
required_checks: UTC-midnight cutoff/boundary and exact one-microsecond non-midnight behavior
simultaneous starts have same cutoff and never consume each other
training, OOF residual and evaluation cutoff consistency
no provider timestamps invented or altered
receipt cutoff equals feature cutoff and all admitted history satisfies embargo
legacy vs aligned controls same-event admission differences labeled
preserve v1/v2 files and existing prospective first-write entries; compare state hashes and numerical parameters
